name: aphrody-local
description: Local marketplace for the aphrody plugin (development install).

plugins.name: aphrody
plugins.description: Pure-Rust single-MCP-server automation surface for Claude Code. ONE native binary `aphrody-mcp` (~9 MB, sub-millisecond cold-start) exposes 42 tools: ex-google_mcp forensics/recon, voice, Context7 + Microsoft Learn docs, PE/ELF RE triage, Gemini web (chat/image/deep-research), screen capture, Adobe Firefly Services (generate/expand/fill), headless cloud Photoshop/Lightroom/Sensei edits, and live in-app Photoshop via a UXP↔WebSocket bridge (batchPlay drives any operation from the inside). Zero JS runtime in the binary, zero secondary MCP server. 2 slash commands (/status, /docs). 19 agents, 28 skills. Cross-platform: Linux #1, Windows #2, WASM #3.

plugins.name: material-design
plugins.description: Guides Claude toward Material Design 3, Google-style, responsive and adaptive UI: 19 skills (design guide, M3 + Google docs, component creation, spec checking, templating, correction, MUI->M3 migration, plus one per @aphrody-code package), 5 agents, a hardcoded-color guard hook, and a bundled mui-docs MCP server. Aligned with the in-repo material-web monorepo (@aphrody-code/m3-*). Merged 2026-06-01.
